verdict_reason: Li et al. define one collection-level ratio, |union_i G_n(y_i)| / sum_i |y_i|, but the implementation averages per-completion ratios: ten duplicate [1, 2] completions measure 1.000000 versus the paper's 0.100000, and the current GPT-2 run measures Distinct-1 0.801215 versus 0.426215 on the identical 1,152 tokens (+87.98%). Texygen's NLTK sentence kernel matches to absolute error 0.000e+00, but BLME restricts each reference set to one prompt rather than the full generated collection, changing the same GPT-2 completions from the source aggregation 0.065155 to 0.046494 (-28.64%).
comparable_reason: Distinct-n and Self-BLEU use model-specific subword IDs: retokenizing the identical 36 GPT-2 texts changes within-prompt Self-BLEU from 0.046494 (GPT-2 IDs) to 0.051053 (Pythia IDs, +9.81%) and to 0.027003 with word tokens (-41.92%), while Distinct-1 moves only 0.801215 to 0.801243. The sampling-entropy support was 50 for GPT-2 and 50-51 for Pythia, so that family avoids a log(vocab_size) ceiling; cross-model use is defensible only with the tokenizer and sampling protocol held fixed or explicitly caveated.
github_reason: Fetched master utils/metrics/SelfBleu.py and executed its exact NLTK sentence_bleu call with uniform 4-gram weights and method1 smoothing; BLME's _self_bleu_single had worst absolute error 0.000e+00 over 600 randomized collections. paper_reason: Li et al. publish Distinct-1/2 values 0.023/0.107 (Twitter baseline) and 0.0056/0.0136 (OpenSubtitles baseline), and Zhu et al. publish Self-BLEU-4 values 0.583-0.848, but their checkpoints and matched generated collections are not this task's GPT-2/hand-prompt protocol, so no published value was reproduced. The local GPT-2 comparison, 0.801215 current versus 0.426215 under Li's formula, is a same-input counterexample rather than a paper-number reproduction.
confounds_reason: A controlled tokenizer-only intervention changes within-prompt Self-BLEU by +9.81%, and the fixed 32-subword budget yielded 25.389-27.111 whitespace words per completion across the four local models (+6.78% span). With only four permitted models, the largest observed rank associations were |rho|=0.894 for several metric/architecture pairs but p=0.106, so tokenizer/architecture confounding is demonstrated as a mechanism but dominance by d_model, n_layers, or vocab_size is not established.
